summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts and chmods the platform-specific executable, and invokes it against a locally-bundled ~727 KB obfuscated JavaScript file `math_init.js`. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are heavily obfuscated: setup.mjs uses hex-named identifiers (`_0xXXXX`) and per-function property-name string maps; math_init.js is a Bun-CJS bundle with a ~4000-element string/number constant array rotated by a shuffle function typical of obfuscator.io transforms. The behavior — fetching an alternate language runtime at install time specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated payload — is unrelated to the package's stated purpose as an identifier SDK, and functions to evade scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code. Installing this package causes attacker-controlled obfuscated code to execute on the installer's machine under a runtime the installer did not request.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
